title: Rava son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 55b, disagreeing there with his father. In Chullin 76a they disagree: “Rabbah said that Rav Assi said; Rabbah bar Rav Huna said that Rav Assi said; and Rava son of Rabbah bar Huna said that Rav Assi said.” In Sotah 49a it reads Abba son of Rabbah bar Rav Huna.
In Chullin 124b: “Rava his son said to Rabbah bar Rav Huna.”
